summary: The profile names the caller of a tagged statement in front of its SQL, as `/* claims_for KIND at FILE:LINE */ SQL`, so the name survives the 240-character cut a profile minute makes to long statements

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Only under ST3_PROFILE_DIR: a tagged statement's text in minutes.jsonl and slow.jsonl starts with `/* TAG */` instead of ending with `-- TAG`, which the cut removed from every history read. Untagged statements are unchanged.

recovery.detail: An older build writes the tag after the SQL again, where long statements lose it.
